name: agents-init
description: Initialize or migrate an Agent project contract; ships with project-orchestrator, agent-pack and opinion-manager.

interface.shortDescription: Initialize or migrate the project skeleton and Project Profile
interface.longDescription: Use agents-init to create or migrate a portable project contract, including a root launcher that opens the project menu without any AI agent. project-orchestrator manages the project lifecycle, agent-pack manages Plugins/Skills/MCP, and opinion-manager manages behavior rules between the user and the Agent; all three ship alongside it as separate plugins. 中文：用 agents-init 创建或迁移可移植项目契约（含不需要 AI Agent 就能打开项目菜单的根目录启动器）。project-orchestrator 管理项目生命周期，agent-pack 管理 Plugin/Skill/MCP，opinion-manager 管理用户与 Agent 之间的行为规则；三者作为独立 Plugin 随同分发。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agents-init to initialize or migrate this project, then use $opinion-manager to configure the Agent behavior rules for this environment.
